descriptionMarkdown:
Malefic- Touched; Universal, Malefic; High-risk damage, fear, possession pressure, daemonic resonance. Using Malefic powers should attract harsher narrative consequences.

Malefic-Touched; When you trigger Perils, your next psychic power deals +1d8 damage.

Malefic-Touched; When you frighten a creature with a Malefic power, you gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

Malefic-Touched; Once per long rest, after triggering Perils, you may choose to gain 1 Corruption to treat the Perils result as Warp Static.
